## Boundaries to review

- [ ] API or DTO contract changed; OpenAPI snapshot is current.
- [ ] Database schema changed; migration is additive and numbered.
- [ ] Authorization or privacy behavior changed; relevant regression coverage is included.
- [ ] Frontend behavior changed; loading, empty, error, and permission states were considered.
- [ ] No shared development or production data/credentials are required for ordinary verification.
